column3: (name): strips the extension and a trailing number, matches the stem against the piccache.hdr groups and the number against the 10-byte entries; returns the entry or 0
blocking read of piccache.hdr into a tagged allocation (0x3e9c0c); turns the two offsets in each 12-byte group into pointers; called from game_loadLevel 0x1e56c4
frees the header allocation and clears 0x3e9c0c; called from the session exit branch 0x323570
frees the least recently used slot that is not being loaded and was last used more than 8 display frames ago (counter 0x44fdd0); clears its block markers; returns 1 if one was freed
once per displayed frame (0x323378): on read completion copies the 64-byte header into the slot and cuts the data into 0x500-byte chained blocks, then starts the next pending piccache.dat read
(name): takes a free slot of 64 (evicting if none), stores the name, block list = -1 (pending), sets the busy flag 0x3e9c00
(name, int *w, int *h): header entry halfwords +6/+8, or zeros when the name is not in the header
(name): slot +0x80 when its blocks are loaded (refreshes last-use), else 0; a name with no slot is queued

(Vec3 *pos, amount): up to 10 scatter tries from g_randSeed with a ground-height test, then news a 0xc0-byte object of class Gold (ctor 0x157668, vtable 0x511a88); earlier draft name loot_spawnScatteredPickup
(Vec3 *pos, descriptor): item_parseDescriptor, free-spot search 0x14acf8, then news the 0x248-byte item prop (ctor 0x155a0c); used by the script dropItem built-ins and Creature_onDeath

(f zOff, f throwSpeed, f goldScale, f goldChance, f qualityRow, f itemChance, Vec3 *pos, angle, reagentFilter, forceSpecial): the death-drop roll, all from g_randSeed: gold, potion or arrows, reagent, figurine, equipment; 61 of 71 call sites are Creature_dropLoot
(wide string): removes a trailing underscore gender/number tag and returns 1-4 for it; rules depend on the language byte 0x44fddc (4 uses one letter, 1 and 3 use two)
(wide string): would prefix a conjunction to strings starting with d,e,?,space; inert because its state word 0x3e9ca8 starts at 0 and nothing else writes it
(src, n, dst): copies the n-th bar-separated alternative of a wide string
(form or -1, text key): looks the key up in the text table (0x173c84) and returns the grammatical form selected by form; result is a pointer into its own stack frame
(item, decorated): display name in the static wide buffer 0x564420 from the definition name key plus prefix and suffix words; word order and agreement depend on language 0x44fddc

(item): gold value. Fixed price (definition +0x14) times count when set, else a formula over damage or armour, raised to a power, plus a term per modifier, times 40 and count; used by the shop and as the budget test in the generators

(item): definition +8 times count, compressed above 5 (armour) or 15, scaled by modifier 0x24 which the parser reads from the weightmodifier token; earlier draft name item_getScaledField08; caller player_itemWeight
(item): definition +0x18 (non-zero on exactly the 236 category-1 definitions) plus modifier 0x0d percent (armorbonus token); earlier draft name item_getModifiedField18
(item): definition +0x1a (non-zero only on weapons, near the mean damage) plus modifier 0x23 percent; Player_recalcDamage adds it to player record +0xcc; meaning of the field not established
adds item_getModifiedField1a to definition +0x0e/+0x10; no caller and no pointer to it

(item, int *min, int *max, withElemental): definition +0x0e/+0x10 scaled by modifier 0x23 percent, optionally plus the two values of modifiers 0x15-0x18 and 0x26; earlier draft name item_getModifiedRange
returns float 1.0; multiplied into the damage range
(item): 7 when item flag bit 33 is set, else 0; only caller is item_selectDrawEffect
(item): bits 11-15 of the item flags = g_randSeed draw modulo the definition's variant count (same bits of definition +0x28); no draw when the count is 0

(out, budget, category or -1, level): 10 random picks from the preset table 0x3ea550 (one seed draw each), keeps the highest value not above budget, adds a required-level modifier from the value; returns 0 if nothing fits
(definition): weapon drop group: 0 for subtype 6 (thrown), 1 for subtype 3 with damage-type bit 8, else 2; -1 for non-weapons
(definition): armour drop group from slot byte +0x1c: 11->0, 4->1, 9->2, 12->3, 3->4, other->5; -1 for non-armour

(out, budget, category, wantSuffix or -1, level): random base definition with every eligible prefix and a random suffix tried, keeps the highest value not above budget; filters cloth armour by how many players have class id 4; all from g_randSeed
(out, level): older generator, one random base, prefix and suffix with no value test; no caller and no pointer to it
(out, level, pictureName or 0): random category-2 definition with flag bit 35 (the reagent drops) between a difficulty floor and level, optionally with a given picture name
(out, level): random category-2 definition with flag bit 45 (the figurine drops) between a difficulty floor and level

(f scale, item): draw-time only. Item flag bit 33 set: fills the effect block 0x3e9cd0 and selects it (0x1797d8 mode 2); clear: mode 0. Callers 0x156db4 and 0x15991c (objects area), Player_drawEquipped, WeaponRack_draw

(text, out, variant or -1, useSpecialTable): builds a 0x48-byte item from name+modifier+modifier text; 42 modifier tokens map to type codes 0-0x28 and 0x2a, a mesh token sets the variant; variant -1 calls item_randomizeVariant (g_randSeed); unknown names fall back to table row 0; 378 call sites
(dst, src): count, flags, prefix/suffix bytes and the four modifiers; zeroes +0x10..+0x1f and +0x22; leaves the definition pointer alone

(list, budget, _, category): up to two tries of item_generateWithAffixes (level 1) for an item not already in the 0x48-stride list (count at +0x1200); 'unique' here means not a duplicate; only caller shop_restockByGold
(item): definition pointer -> (pointer - 0x3f7650) / 64 in place; preset-table rows come out negative; used by save_snapshotPlayer
(item): inverse of item_encodeDefinitionIndex
(out, bodyType, item): picture/texture file name from the definition's picture name or model-table row, the variant, the prefix's colour index and, for worn armour, a body-type code from 0x4026d8
(bodyType, item): picCache_getOrRequestPicture of that name; while it is not loaded returns a fixed placeholder picture from equipmnt.lmp
(bodyType, item, int *w, int *h)
(item): row of the model table 0x3e9ce0 = definition +0x34, plus the variant when item flag bit 36 is set

resolves every model-table row's two file names to pointers in equipmnt.lmp, and a shot animation for bow definitions (+0x38); also parses every base definition with variant -1, which advances g_randSeed once per definition that has variants (223); called from game_loadLevel 0x1e56bc when hud.lmp is not loaded
(out): g_randSeed picks a mana, healing or recall potion; size from the level rating 0x4f714c and min(difficulty, 3)
parses every preset-table row and discards the result; no caller and no pointer to it
(a, b): b has a definition and a, b agree on definition, 64-bit flags and the word at +0x20 (prefix, suffix)

returns 0x344 = rows of the preset table including its terminator, i.e. the distance in rows from 0x3ea550 to the base table; player_importCharacter uses it to rebase negative item indices; earlier draft name item_getConstant344
(f halfSize, Vec3 *centre): world_collectObjectsInBox, counts objects with flags & 0x68 == 0x20
(f dist, Vec3 *out, creature, target): three forward rays (centre and both edges), keeps a side choice in creature +0x2f8 (0 none, 1, 2), returns a sideways offset of two radii
(creature, Vec3 *delta, hitOut): first blocked fraction among centre, left-edge and right-edge rays (0x18ad94); 1.0 when clear
(Vec3 *out, creature, Vec3 *dest): a point 1200 units along the straight line when clear, else along facing or facing +-0x2000 depending on side probes; only caller Creature_moveTo

(f inner, f outer, attacker, Vec3 *centre, minDmg, maxDmg, flags, descriptor): box query; for creature attackers asks vtable slot 20 (is enemy); damage falls off linearly between the radii; calls damage_apply 0x1e8230

(f dist, creature, Vec3 *lookAt or 0): one g_randSeed draw picks the sweep direction, up to 32 headings tested by ray and ground height, moves the creature to the best one, relinks it in the grid (0x14f028), optionally faces lookAt
